description: Hand-labeled gold set for evaluating the extraction pipeline. Each PEP entry contains the alternatives and objections I identified by reading the Rejected Ideas and Backwards Compatibility sections myself.

alternatives.name: Use existing annotation meaning from PEP 3107

objections.text: Type hints will make Python feel like a statically typed language
Runtime performance concerns from annotation evaluation
Protocols add another way to define interfaces alongside ABCs

alternatives.name: Lazy evaluation via descriptors or thunks
Keep eager evaluation with improved forward references

objections.text: Stringification breaks runtime uses of annotations
Libraries relying on get_type_hints may behave differently
Code that accesses __annotations__ directly will get strings
The from __future__ import annotations mechanism creates confusing behavior

alternatives.name: Functional syntax as the primary form

objections.text: TypedDict adds another way to define structured types

alternatives.name: Automatic type narrowing from isinstance patterns
Make PEP 563 stringified annotations the default
Supporting direct reference or modification of local __annotations__

objections.text: variables referenced in annotations are mutated
__annotations__ dict directly in module or class scope

alternatives.name: Use angle brackets for type parameters

objections.text: New syntax adds learning cost and creates two ways to do the same thing

alternatives.name: Fix TypeGuard to narrow in both branches

objections.text: TypeIs and TypeGuard are easy to confuse
